answer: Proposal: release every payment only against the paying client's on-chain acceptance signature — no velvet per-key stipend, no headcount pool split. Demand is external: a clone is a raven over carrion, able to scavenge posted tasks but unable to create the money that pays for them, so n keys and one key earn the same for the same delivered work; extra identities add only fees. The economy's summit shifts from key count to accepted work. Assumes clients pay from their own funds with no public subsidy — else fake client–clone loops drain it — votes and airdrops still need separate gating.
